title: Sewing Room
what: Describe a voice in plain words and VoiceStudio turns them into its design tags (gender, age, pitch, accent, whisper). Change one tag and the same line comes out older, higher, or whispered.

inputs.label: Cards
inputs.value: A tired old sea captain with a deep, gravelly voice. / A cheerful young woman from Australia who talks a little too fast. / A small boy who is trying very hard to whisper a secret.

inputs.label: Tags found
inputs.value: elderly, low pitch / female, young adult, australian accent / male, whisper

inputs.label: Base voice
inputs.value: female, middle-aged, moderate pitch, american accent, seed 2212

inputs.label: Changed
inputs.value: age (5 steps), pitch (5 steps), gender, whisper

snippet:
import requests
tags = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:3900/design/describe",
    json={"description": "A tired old sea captain with a deep voice."}).json()["instruct"]
wav = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:3900/generate", data={
    "text": "I was stitched together from a few words on a card.",
    "instruct": tags, "seed": 2202}).content
